'''Southern Mustafarians''' were a subspecies of [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarians]], being one of two. Southern Mustafarians were shorter and burlier than their [[Northern Mustafarian/Legends|northern counterparts]], and they could resist greater temperatures. Mustafarians evolved from extremophile arthropods living in caves of dormant [[Volcano/Legends|volcanoes]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
